statusHistory.note: FOODIE-9000 byline. Verified via EV Grieve (local East Village blog, two posts tracking the buildout and grand opening) and Shelf Awareness (book-trade press): mother-daughter owners Marianna Vaidman Stone and Emily Samara Stone, 170 Avenue A (former 7-Eleven corner space), opened Saturday August 15, 2026. Café by day, bar by night; international-literature focus; Parisian book-cafe / Irish pub-snug inspiration per owner quote in coverage.
